verdicts.reason: A shrinks the green circle into a small blob stuck behind the phone's lower-left corner. The headline runs almost edge to edge, the two badges are staggered on different left edges, and SUMMER ONLY nearly touches the right edge and crowds the CTA. All the text is jammed together while the bottom ~20% of the canvas is empty. B keeps the circle and phone intact, with a clear top-to-bottom flow from brand to headline to product to CTA. Its flaws: the badges now sit below the CTA, there is a big gap between the headline and the phone, alignment switches from a left-aligned headline to centred badges, and the sub-copy is tiny.
